title: Cyrus and the Playlist
author: Casper Yarrow
blurb: Ada Okonkwo, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the college essay prompt asks one honest question nobody can stop answering — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must win the championship that doesn't matter — and the one that does, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
